The crowd went wild over Narita Brian's 
conquest of the Satsuki Sho: "A Triple 
Crown Umamusume is all but guaranteed...!" 
The shock rippled through the other racers 
of her generation.

Realizing there were formidable rivals 
even among her own generation, Narita 
Brian felt an unprecedented rush of 
exhilaration.

Her next race is the second leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown. She will be running 
in the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).
